_about: Proposed per-card staging lines for the F6.2 re-render (Fable, 2026-10-11). Same format as card_notes.json: inserted right after the Subject sentence by deck_builder.build_call. Keeps and amends all existing entries. See staging_existing.md for tiers and rationale.
_settings_policy: go_settings.assign currently skips every key present in card_notes. Replace skip=set(CARD_NOTES) with skip=set(_settings_embedded) so the bank Setting line still appends after these notes; the notes are written so the subject stays central with the setting behind. Also honour settings_assignments.mode: prefix interior-mode lines with 'Through the window:' and inset-mode lines with 'In one inset:'.

notes.022_bilietas: Main picture: a small cardboard railway ticket held up large between a conductor's finger and thumb, a ticket punch in the other hand making a round hole in it, the ticket face blank; behind, a railway carriage compartment with a passenger seated by the window. The punched ticket is the subject. Insets: a ticket window with a hand sliding a ticket under the glass; a ticket punch; a passenger showing a ticket to the conductor in the aisle.
notes.024_miestas: A Lithuanian city: five-storey panel blocks and older plastered buildings along a wide street, a trolleybus and Zhiguli cars, pedestrians, a church tower in the distance; the busy street with its buildings and traffic is the subject, people secondary. Insets: a rooftop skyline; a pedestrian crossing with civilians and cars; a kiosk with a queue.
notes.025_namas: A single-storey wooden farmhouse with carved window surrounds and shutters, a picket fence, and a well-sweep standing over its timber well-head with a bucket on the pole; one person in the yard. The house has crossed horse-head boards at the roof ridge and a small glazed porch.
notes.026_butas: Main picture: a five-storey panel apartment block seen from the front, one single flat marked by a bold black arrow at its balcony and lit window; a woman watering a flower box on that balcony. One flat within the block is the subject. Insets: the flat's front door on a stairwell landing with its number plate blank; the flat's living room with a sofa, a wall unit and a television; the mailbox bank in the entrance hall.
notes.027_gatve: Main picture: a town street seen along its length at eye level, a two-lane asphalt roadway with a painted centre line and a zebra crossing in the foreground, kerbs and pavements on both sides, a Zhiguli and an Ikarus bus on the road, pedestrians on the pavements, three- and four-storey plastered houses with shop fronts on either side, a street lamp and a road sign on a post. The roadway and its traffic are the subject. Insets: a close-up of the kerb, pavement and a storm drain; a pedestrian crossing at the zebra; a street lamp on its post.
notes.028_kelias: Main picture: an asphalt country road running straight away from the viewer between flat fields to a tree-ringed farmstead, a milestone post without lettering at the verge, a horse cart and a distant lorry on it. The road surface receding into the distance is the subject. Insets: a road sign post with a blank board; a cyclist on the road; the road's gravel edge and ditch.
notes.029_oro_uostas: Main picture: a low airport terminal building with a control tower and large glass front, a passenger airliner standing on the apron behind it with steps at its door, passengers crossing the apron with suitcases, a fuel truck. The terminal with the aircraft behind it is the subject. Insets: the departures hall with a blank board and benches; a suitcase on a baggage trolley; the control tower.
notes.030_stotis: Main picture: a railway platform with a green diesel locomotive and two passenger carriages standing at it, carriage doors open, passengers with suitcases boarding and alighting, the station building with its clock and canopy along the platform, rails running out of frame. The train at the platform is the subject. Insets: the station clock; a ticket window with a queue; a bench with a waiting family.
notes.031_tiltas: Main picture: a steel-girder river bridge seen from the bank, its arches and piers over flowing water, a bus and pedestrians crossing it; the bridge span is the subject, with towers of the town behind. Insets: a bridge pier in the water; a close-up of the railing; a boat passing under an arch.
notes.032_viesbutis: Main picture: a hotel front with a glass entrance under a canopy, a doorman in a peaked cap holding the door, an arriving guest with a suitcase, taxis at the kerb, rows of identical windows with balconies above. The hotel entrance with doorman and guest is the subject. Insets: the reception desk with a wall rack of room keys; a tidy hotel room with a single bed and bedside lamp; a suitcase on a luggage stand.
notes.033_restoranas: Main picture: a restaurant dining room with white tablecloths, several tables of diners, a waiter in a dark waistcoat carrying plates, a menu card standing blank on the nearest table, a cloakroom and the lit street door behind. The dining room with its waiter and tables is the subject. Insets: the restaurant front with a small awning and lit windows at dusk; a plate of cutlets with potatoes and a glass of compote; the waiter writing an order.
notes.034_ukis: Main picture: a farmstead yard: a long wooden farmhouse with a half-hipped roof, a barn and a log granary around a swept yard, a tractor with a trailer of hay, hens and a dog, a farm woman with a bucket, a field of rye beyond the fence. The working farmyard is the subject. Insets: cows in a byre; a farmer on the tractor; a pile of potatoes in sacks.
notes.035_teismas: Main picture: a courtroom seen from the gallery: a judge in a dark robe at a raised bench with a gavel, a clerk below, a witness at a stand, lawyers at two tables, the public on benches; the judge at the bench is the subject. Insets: the gavel on its block; the courthouse front with columns; the scales of justice.
notes.036_mokykla: Main picture: a two-storey school building seen from the front, long rows of large identical classroom windows, a flagpole with the tricolour and a wide entrance with steps, a stream of children with satchels and white collars going up the steps, a teacher holding the door, a bell on a bracket beside it, the paved schoolyard and a football goal to one side. The school building with its children is the subject. Insets: a classroom with a teacher at a chalkboard bearing only a simple diagram and pupils at desks; children playing in the schoolyard; a satchel, slate and pencil case.
notes.037_biuras: Main picture: an office room with four desks, clerks at typewriters and telephones, filing cabinets, a wall clock, in-trays of paper, a window onto the street; the office with its desks and clerks is the subject. Insets: a typewriter with a page in it; a rotary telephone and a notepad; a filing cabinet drawer of folders.
notes.038_kambarys: Main picture: a single plain living room seen square-on from its open doorway, the door frame framing the view: one window with curtains, a table with two chairs, a wardrobe, a rug, a ceiling lamp, a radiator under the window; one person standing inside near the window. The room as an enclosed space is the subject. Insets: the door handle and the door standing open; the window from inside; a floor plan of the single room drawn as a simple outline.
notes.039_miestelis: Main picture: a small town main street of low wooden and brick houses with shop fronts, a cobbled square with a kiosk and a bus stop, a modest church spire small in the distance, townspeople with baskets; the little town street is the subject. Insets: a row of low wooden houses along a dirt road; a small wooden kiosk with a queue; a horse cart at the square.
notes.040_universitetas: Main picture: a university main building with a columned portico and wide steps, young adult students with books and folders on the steps and in the courtyard arch, a bicycle rack; the building with its students is the subject. Insets: a lecture hall with tiered benches and a lecturer; a student reading in the courtyard; a stack of textbooks and a notebook.
notes.041_klubas: The hall itself as the subject: a low stage with a small band, a bar or cloakroom, the lit entrance in an inset; dancers secondary.
notes.042_baras: Main picture: a small bar interior: a wooden counter with a barman in a waistcoat pouring beer from a tap, bottles on shelves behind, three men on stools with glasses, a round table of drinkers, a coat hook row; the counter and barman are the subject. Insets: a beer mug and a glass of vodka on the counter; the bar's street door with a lamp; a bowl of salted sprats.
notes.043_parkas: Main picture: a public park: gravel paths between tall trees, benches with old men playing chess and a mother with a pram, a flower bed, a bandstand, a lamp post; the paths, benches and trees are the subject. Insets: a park bench close-up; children on a swing; a flower bed with a low iron fence.
notes.044_stovykla: Main picture: a lakeside campsite: three canvas ridge tents in a row under pines, a campfire with a kettle on a tripod, young people in jumpers sitting on logs, a rucksack and a rolled sleeping mat; the tents around the fire are the subject. Insets: a tent being pegged down; a kettle over the fire; a rucksack and boots.
notes.045_parduotuve: Main picture: a small grocery shop interior with a long counter, a shop assistant in a white smock weighing goods on a dial scale, shelves of tins, jars and loaves behind her, a queue of three customers with string bags; the counter and shelves are the subject. Insets: the shop front with its glass door and a blank sign board; a hand paying coins at the till; a string bag of groceries.
notes.046_teatras: The stage set is a plain painted landscape backdrop between red velvet curtains, the actors in simple period costume; the stage furniture is a bench and a table. The audience heads are varied in hair and age. Insets: the columned theatre front with people arriving; the foyer with coats being handed in; a wall sconce lamp.
notes.047_biblioteka: Main picture: a library reading room with tall shelves of books along the walls, long tables where readers sit over open books under green-shaded lamps, a librarian at a front desk stamping a book, a card catalogue cabinet with small drawers. The reading room and its shelves are the subject. Insets: the library building front; a hand pulling a book from a shelf; a stack of books with a reader's card.
notes.048_ligonine: Main picture: a hospital building front with a red cross over the entrance, an ambulance with a red cross at the door, two orderlies in white carrying a stretcher, a nurse in a white cap; the building with the ambulance is the subject. Insets: a ward with a patient in bed and a doctor; a nurse pushing a wheelchair; a plain red cross in a circle.
notes.049_baznycia: A whitewashed village church with a separate wooden bell tower and a carved wooden roadside cross by the gate; a few villagers in their Sunday best walking toward it, the men bareheaded at the door.
notes.050_turgus: Main picture: an open-air market under a long low roof: wooden stalls heaped with cabbages, apples, carrots and jars, dial scales on each stall, several stallholders of clearly different age, build and headscarf colour behind separate stalls, buyers with string bags; one stallholder looks toward the viewer, the others at customers or their scales. Insets: the market gate; a basket of apples and a jar of honey; coins paid into a hand.
notes.053_zeme: Main picture: the GROUND as a surface: a man's boots standing on packed bare earth with a few stones and tufts of grass, seen low, a bold black arrow pointing down at the ground under his feet; a dropped apple lying on the ground beside him. The ground underfoot is the subject. Insets: a child sitting on the ground; a ball resting on the ground; a close-up of bare earth with pebbles.
notes.055_bankas: Main picture: a bank hall interior: a cashier behind a counter grille counting banknotes onto the counter for a customer, a second window with a queue, a large iron safe door open in the wall behind, marble floor and columns. The counter with money changing hands is the subject. Insets: the bank building front with its columned entrance; a stack of banknotes and a coin tray; a savings book being stamped.
notes.056_vieta: Main picture: a plan of a town square drawn on a sheet, a forefinger pressing one exact spot on it where a small red circle marks the place; two people beside it looking at the marked spot. The marked spot on the plan is the subject. Insets: a park bench with an arrow marking the exact spot in front of it; a chalk X on a pavement; a signpost at a crossroads with blank boards.
notes.066_paltas: Standing man in a flat cap, near-frontal three-quarter view, face turned only a little, eyes resting just past the viewer's shoulder; the coat flat-laid beside him as the main subject.
notes.080_sunus: Father standing with his young son at his side, the boy with a satchel, a bold black arrow above the boy; the father looks down at the boy, the boy faces the viewer. Insets: the boy with a football; the boy at a school desk; the father's hand on the boy's shoulder.
notes.081_dukra: Mother standing with her young daughter, the girl with ribbons in her plaits, a bold black arrow above the girl; the mother looks at the girl, the girl faces the viewer. Insets: the girl with a doll; the girl skipping rope; the mother plaiting the girl's hair.
notes.082_motina: A mother holding a small child on her hip in a kitchen doorway, looking at the child; the child faces the viewer. Insets: a mother tying a child's scarf; a mother reading to a child; a pram.
notes.083_tevas: A father holding a small child's hand, both walking, the father in a flat cap looking ahead, the child looking up at him. Insets: a father lifting a child onto his shoulders; a father mending a bicycle with the child watching; a father's large hand holding a small one.
notes.084_tevai: A mother and father standing side by side, bold black arrows above both adults, their small child standing apart beside them; one parent faces the viewer, the other looks at the child.
notes.085_kudikis: A swaddled baby lying in a wooden cradle, eyes open, a knitted bonnet; the baby faces the viewer. Insets: a feeding bottle; a mother lifting the baby; a pram outside a house.
notes.086_vyras: A grown man standing near-frontal in a jacket and open-collared shirt, flat cap in hand, eyes just past the viewer; a plain street behind. Insets: a man shaving at a mirror; a man carrying a briefcase; a man's heavy wristwatch and wedding ring.
notes.087_moteris: A grown woman standing near-frontal in a plain dress and cardigan, hair set, a handbag on her arm, eyes just past the viewer; a plain street behind. Insets: a woman tying a headscarf; a woman carrying a string bag; a woman's low-heeled shoes.
notes.088_brolis: Two brothers close in age and alike in features standing shoulder to shoulder, one a little taller, a bold black arrow above one of them; one faces the viewer, the other looks at his brother. Insets: the two boys kicking a ball; the two sharing a bicycle; the two at a table over a board game.
notes.089_sesuo: Two sisters, an older and a younger girl, standing side by side with plaits, a bold black arrow above one of them; one faces the viewer, the other looks at her sister. Insets: the two girls skipping rope; the older plaiting the younger's hair; the two sharing a book.
notes.090_seima: Main picture: the family of four at an everyday meal at the kitchen table, bowls of soup, dark rye bread and tea; one parent facing the viewer with eyes just past the viewer's shoulder, the other parent turned toward the children, the children looking at each other or at their plates. Insets: the family gathering potatoes in the garden; the family walking together along a street.
notes.091_senelis: An elderly grandfather with a walking stick and a moustache sitting on a bench before a log house, a child at his knee; he looks at the child, the child faces the viewer. Insets: the grandfather whittling a spoon; a pipe and a cap; the grandfather and child feeding ducks.
notes.092_senele: An elderly grandmother in a cotton headscarf with set grey hair showing at the front, hands folded, a child beside her; she looks at the child, the child looks just past the viewer.
notes.093_vyras: A married couple standing together, the husband in a suit, a bold black arrow above the husband, both wedding rings visible on their hands held together; the husband faces the viewer, the wife looks at him. Insets: a close-up of the two ringed hands; the couple at a kitchen table; the husband hanging a picture while the wife points.
notes.094_zmona: A married couple standing together, the wife in a good dress with a cardigan, a bold black arrow above the wife, both wedding rings visible on their hands held together; the wife faces the viewer, the husband looks at her. Insets: a close-up of the two ringed hands; the couple at a kitchen table; the wife pouring tea for the husband.
notes.095_karalius: A king seated on a throne in a crown and ermine-trimmed mantle holding a sceptre, drawn as a storybook figure; he faces the viewer. Insets: the crown alone on a cushion; the sceptre and orb; a castle keep on a hill.
notes.096_karaliene: A queen seated on a throne in a crown and mantle, drawn as a storybook figure; she faces the viewer. Insets: the crown alone on a cushion; a royal ring; a castle keep on a hill.
notes.097_prezidentas: A man and a woman president at matching plain podiums draped with the tricolour, one speaking with a raised hand toward the viewer, the other looking at the first. Insets: the president signing a document at a desk; the president shaking a hand before a crowd; the tricolour on a flagpole before a government building.
notes.098_kaimynas: Two neighbours, a man and a woman, greeting each other over a low garden fence between two farmsteads, one raising a hand; one faces the viewer, the other faces across the fence. Insets: a watering can handed over the fence; a plate of pancakes passed across; two adjoining gates.
notes.099_berniukas: A young boy of about ten in a cap and jacket standing near-frontal holding a fishing rod and a small perch, eyes just past the viewer. Insets: the boy on a bicycle; the boy with a satchel; the boy's tackle box.
notes.100_mergaite: A young girl of about ten with plaits and ribbons sitting at a desk writing in an exercise book, looking at her page. Insets: the girl with a skipping rope; the girl holding a kitten; her pencil case and abacus.
notes.101_vaikas: An age row, a baby, a child, a teenager and a grown adult standing in a line from smallest to tallest, one bold black arrow above the child; the child faces the viewer, the others look along the row.
notes.102_suauges: A man and a woman standing beside a small child, bold black arrows above the two adults; one adult faces the viewer, the other looks at the child.
notes.103_zmogus: One ordinary person standing upright near-frontal in plain clothes, arms relaxed, eyes just past the viewer; beside them a simple outline figure as a diagram. Insets: a hand; a face in profile; a footprint.
notes.104_draugas: Two men friends with arms around each other's shoulders laughing together on a river bank; one faces the viewer, the other looks at his friend. Insets: two friends clinking beer mugs; two friends fishing side by side; two hands clasped.
notes.105_auka: An injured person lying on a stretcher carried by two aides in civil-defence armbands, a bandaged head, the aides looking at the patient. Insets: a first-aid kit with a red cross; a blanket wrapped around shoulders; an ambulance door.
notes.106_zaidejas: A man and a woman player in plain jerseys and shorts on a sports field, one dribbling a football, the other running alongside; one glances toward the viewer. Insets: a football; a pair of boots with studs; a referee's whistle.
notes.107_sirgalius: A man and a woman spectator in a stadium stand holding a tricolour scarf up with both hands and shouting; one faces the viewer, the other looks at the pitch. Insets: a football pitch with players far below; a rattle and a scarf; a crowd of spectators.
notes.108_minia: Main subject: a dense standing crowd of ordinary townspeople, many heads deep, filling the picture; faces at mixed angles, several turned to neighbours, a few facing forward with eyes just past the viewer. Insets: a queue boarding a bus; a crowded tram stop (both crowds, so the insets vote for the target word).
notes.109_asmuo: Main picture: a plain row of seven standing silhouettes drawn as flat dark shapes, one figure in the row drawn in full colour and detail, an ordinary man in a jacket, standing near-frontal with eyes just past the viewer; a bold black arrow above him. The one individual among the many is the subject. Insets: an identity photograph in a small frame; a single chair at a table set for one; a hand holding a single pass card.
notes.110_mokytojas: A man and a woman teacher at a chalkboard, with three or four pupils at wooden school desks in the foreground, seen from behind and in profile; the woman lean with straight light-brown hair, the man side-parted; one teacher faces the class (the viewer), the other points at the board. The pupils are essential to the card.
notes.111_studentas: A man and a woman student, young adults with books and folders, seated in a tiered lecture hall, one writing notes, the other looking at the lecturer at the lectern; one faces the viewer. Insets: a stack of textbooks; a student card held in a hand; students on the university steps.
notes.112_advokatas: Main picture: a man and a woman lawyer in dark suits at a courtroom lawyers' table with files and law books, one standing and addressing the bench with an open hand, the other seated writing; the judge's raised bench and the scales of justice on the wall behind. The lawyers at their table are the subject. Insets: a leather briefcase with a folded document; a client across a desk from a lawyer; a row of thick law books.
notes.113_gydytojas: Keep the small red cross on the clinic building or medical kit; one doctor facing the viewer, the other attending to a patient.
notes.114_pacientas: One patient as the subject, sitting up in a single iron hospital bed with the blanket over the legs and a thermometer on the bedside table, a nurse at the bedside turned toward the patient; the patient faces the viewer, the nurse looks at the patient. The bed stands alone against the ward wall. Insets: a medicine bottle, tablets and a glass of water; a doctor listening with a stethoscope; a patient being wheeled in on a trolley.
notes.115_padavejas: A man and a woman waiter each carrying a loaded tray between restaurant tables, one in a dark waistcoat and bow tie, the other in a white apron; one looks at the tray, the other toward the viewer. Insets: a tray with glasses and plates; a folded napkin and cutlery; a waiter writing an order at a table.
notes.116_sekretorius: A man and a woman secretary at typewriters at side-by-side desks with telephones, in-trays and a shorthand pad, one typing, the other answering the telephone; one faces the viewer. Insets: a typewriter with a page in it; a telephone and appointment diary; a filing cabinet.
notes.117_kunigas: A priest in a black cassock and white collar standing near-frontal on church steps with a prayer book, eyes just past the viewer, a few parishioners in Sunday best behind him. Insets: the priest at the altar with a chalice; a confessional; the priest blessing a child.
notes.118_policininkas: A man and a woman traffic officer in service uniform and peaked caps standing in the middle of a street crossing among cars and a bus, one raising a striped baton to halt traffic, the other waving a car on; one faces the viewer. Insets: the striped baton; a whistle; an officer at a car window.
notes.119_policija: A group of five uniformed police officers of different build and age standing beside a patrol car with a roof light, one speaking into a radio handset; one faces the viewer. Insets: the patrol car; a peaked cap and badge-free shoulder board; a police station door.
notes.120_kariuomene: A column of soldiers in field uniform and helmets marching in step down a road, rifles shouldered, an officer at the side; the column is the subject. Insets: a soldier's boots in step; an army truck; a line of tents.
notes.121_kareivis: A single soldier in field uniform and helmet standing near-frontal at ease with a rifle slung, eyes just past the viewer. Insets: the helmet; the soldier's kit bag; the soldier writing a letter on his knee.
notes.122_menininkas: A man and a woman artist painting at easels outdoors above a river, one turned to the viewer with brush raised, the other at work on the canvas. Insets: a palette and brushes; a box of paint tubes; a finished landscape canvas.
notes.123_autorius: Main picture: a man and a woman author each at a typewriter at a shared desk piled with manuscript pages, one pulling a finished page from the machine, the other reading a page; a shelf behind holds many copies of the same thick book with a blank spine. The writers at their typewriters are the subject. Insets: a hand correcting a typed page with a pen; a stack of bound manuscript with a ribbon; an open book on a reader's lap.
notes.124_vadovas: A man and a woman manager standing before seated staff, one pointing at a wall chart of plain bars and lines, the other holding a folder; one faces the staff, the other toward the viewer. Insets: a desk with a telephone and papers; a hand pointing at a chart; a factory floor seen through an office window.
notes.125_zurnalistas: A man and a woman reporter, one holding a microphone to a passer-by, the other writing in a notebook, a photographer behind; one faces the viewer. Insets: a notebook and pen; a microphone; a camera with flash.
notes.126_aktorius: A man and a woman actor performing on a lit stage in period costume, one with an arm raised in declamation, the other reacting; the audience heads below. Insets: the comic and tragic masks; a dressing-room mirror with bulbs; a bow before the curtain.
notes.128_religija: A calm specimen chart: a village church with a tower, a lit candle, a closed holy book with a plain cross on its cover, and two hands folded in prayer, arranged in four quiet cells; a woman in a headscarf praying in one corner.
notes.129_dangus: A tall pair of pearly gates standing open onto golden clouds, shafts of light, a throne far within, a few robed figures and a small angel; drawn as a calm instructional diagram.
notes.130_pragaras: Red flames filling a cavern, a red horned devil with a forked tail and a pitchfork, a stern face, a few small figures labouring in the heat; drawn as a calm instructional diagram.
notes.131_mirtis: Main picture: a plain gravestone in a quiet cemetery with wilting flowers at its base and a mourning woman in black standing beside it with bowed head; a bold black arrow at the gravestone. Insets: a wreath; a funeral candle; a clock stopped with its hands still.
notes.132_vaistai: A brown medicine bottle, a spoon of syrup and a blister pack of tablets on a bedside table, a bold black arrow at them; a mother giving a child the spoon in an inset. Insets: the mother and child; a pharmacy counter with a woman in a white coat; a thermometer.
notes.133_pinigai: A fan of interwar Lithuanian litas banknotes with plain ornament drawn as shapes, and a scatter of litas coins, on a wooden table; two hands counting them. Insets: a purse; a till drawer; a hand paying at a counter.
notes.134_doleris: A single US one-dollar banknote and a coin lying on a table, a bold black arrow on the note, drawn with its portrait oval and ornament as plain shapes; a Lithuanian litas note beside it for contrast.
notes.135_banknotas: A single interwar Lithuanian litas banknote held up between two fingers, its ornament and portrait drawn as plain shapes, a bold black arrow on the note.
notes.136_santuoka: A bride in a white dress and veil and a groom in a dark suit exchanging rings before a registry official at a desk with a tricolour; the couple look at each other, the official faces the viewer. Insets: the joined hands with rings; a marriage certificate bearing only a plain round seal; the couple cutting a cake.
notes.137_vestuves: Bride and groom looking at each other or at the ring; one guest facing the viewer, the others watching the couple.
notes.138_komanda: A football team of eleven players in matching green jerseys lined up in a row with a coach at the end, each face different in hair and build; two face the viewer, the rest look along the row. Insets: the team captain's armband; a team photograph in a frame; the team huddled.
notes.139_santykiai: Two people, a man and a woman, standing face to face holding both hands, a small linked-chain symbol drawn between them; both look at each other. Insets: two friends sharing a bench; a mother and daughter embracing; two colleagues shaking hands.
notes.140_rase: A ring of linked human hands of many skin tones, and behind it a circle of human profiles of different features and hair; a small tricolour in one corner. Insets: three faces side by side of different origin; a globe; children of different origins holding hands.
notes.141_seksas: A closed hotel room door with a small hanging tag on the handle, a man's and a woman's shoes left together on the mat outside, a champagne bottle and two glasses on a tray beside them, soft lamplight under the door; the closed door is the subject.
notes.142_lytis: A man and a woman standing side by side near-frontal, the Mars symbol drawn above the man and the Venus symbol above the woman; both look a little past the viewer. Insets: a men's room pictogram; a women's room pictogram; a baby's pink and blue bonnets.
notes.143_zmogzudyste: A stark black silhouette of one figure stabbing another in the back with a knife, drawn flat as a warning pictogram against the cream paper; a chalk body outline in an inset. Insets: the chalk outline; two detectives examining the ground; a court bench.
notes.144_kalejimas: A grey stone prison building with barred windows, a high wall topped with wire, a watchtower and an iron gate, a guard at the gate; the prison building is the subject. Insets: a barred window close-up; a cell with a bunk; a heavy key ring.
notes.145_technologija: A calm specimen chart of period machines in four cells: a rotary telephone, a tabletop radio, a tractor and a rocket on its pad; a technician with a screwdriver in one corner.
notes.146_energija: A lightning bolt striking a tall pylon, power lines humming with drawn vibration marks, a large battery with its terminals and a glowing bulb beside it; the lightning and lines are the subject. Insets: a hydroelectric dam; a coal shovel at a furnace; a windmill.
notes.147_karas: Refugees looking along the road ahead; one child glancing back toward the viewer. The only arrow, if any, points at the soldiers and tank on the horizon.
notes.148_taika: Main picture: a field gathering of long-haired young people of 1981 sitting on the grass with guitars and flowers, a white dove with an olive sprig flying above them, a drawn peace symbol on a plain banner with nothing written on it; a tricolour on a pole at the edge. The calm gathering with the dove is the subject. Insets: two hands shaking; a rifle laid down with a flower in its barrel; children playing in a sunlit yard.
notes.149_puolimas: A sergeant standing and gesturing his squad forward with a sweeping arm as soldiers run crouched toward a low concrete pillbox; the forward charge is the subject; one soldier glances toward the viewer. Insets: the pillbox; a soldier running with a rifle; a trench.
notes.150_rinkimai: A hand dropping a folded ballot paper into a sealed wooden ballot box with a slot, a queue of voters with coats behind, a curtained voting booth at the side; the ballot going into the box is the subject. Insets: the voting booth; a ballot paper bearing only plain tick boxes; a voter showing a pass card.
notes.151_zurnalas: The front cover of a glossy cultural magazine lying closed on a table, its cover picture a painting of a Lithuanian landscape, its masthead as permitted by the text rule; a reader's glasses beside it. Insets: a newsstand with magazines; a hand turning a page; a stack of back issues.
notes.152_laikrastis: A folded broadsheet newspaper on a kitchen table, its columns drawn as grey blocks and plain lines, a masthead band as permitted by the text rule, a cup of tea beside it; a man reading it with glasses. Insets: a newspaper kiosk; a paperboy with a bag; a hand turning a page.
notes.153_nuodai: A dark glass bottle with a plain skull-and-crossbones label standing apart on a high shelf, a padlocked cupboard door beside it; a mother lifting a child away from the shelf. Insets: a skull-and-crossbones sign; rubber gloves; a toadstool.
notes.154_ginklas: A plain wall rack in a hunting lodge displaying a wooden-stocked hunting rifle, a double-barrelled shotgun, a bow and a quiver of arrows, with a game bag below; the rifle is the subject. Insets: a cartridge belt; a hunting horn; a hunter walking with a dog.
notes.155_sportas: A calm specimen chart in four cells: footballers, a runner on a track, two boxers, a swimmer; each cell a different sport.
notes.157_manksta: A plain gymnasium hall with wall bars, one man doing a star jump at the centre, arms and legs spread, others doing knee bends behind; one faces the viewer. Insets: a skipping rope; a medicine ball; morning exercises on a lawn.
notes.158_kamuolys: A single black-and-white football resting on grass, large and central, a bold black arrow at it; children on a pitch far behind. Insets: a volleyball; a child's rubber ball; a foot about to kick the ball.
notes.159_zaidimas: Children of different ages gathered around a kitchen table playing a board game with a folded board, dice and wooden counters, one child moving a counter, one laughing; one faces the viewer. Insets: the dice; a deck of cards; children playing hopscotch outside.
notes.160_kaina: A market stall of apples with a large hand-written price tag propped on them, a bold black arrow at the tag, a buyer's hand holding coins; the price tag is the subject.
notes.161_sutartis: Two people shaking hands over a signed document on a desk, the document bearing a plain scribbled signature line and a round official stamp, a fountain pen beside it; one faces the viewer. Insets: the stamp pressed on paper; a pen signing; two folders exchanged.
notes.162_narkotikas: A syringe and hand-rolled cigarettes scattered on the dirty ground of a back alley by a wall, drawn as a civil-defence warning, a bold black arrow at them; a figure slumped on a bench in an inset. Insets: the slumped figure; a locked medicine cabinet; a police car at the alley mouth.
notes.163_zenklas: A triangular red-bordered roadside warning sign on a post with its face blank white, at a country road verge; a cyclist slowing before it. Insets: a round blue sign with a blank face; a signpost with blank arms; a hand pointing at the sign.
notes.164_mokslas: A laboratory bench with a bubbling flask on a burner, a microscope, a rack of test tubes and a simple drawn atom diagram on a chart behind; a man and a woman in white coats, one looking into the microscope, one toward the viewer. Insets: a test tube held to the light; a notebook of plain diagrams; a planetary model.
notes.165_dievas: A calm instructional version of two hands reaching across clouds almost touching, the robed bearded figure on the left among the clouds and a man in plain 1981 clothes on the right. Insets: a church tower; a candle; folded hands.
notes.166_grupe: A small amateur band of four on a low stage: accordion, guitar, double bass and a drum kit, playing together; one faces the viewer. Insets: the accordion close-up; the drum; dancers before the stage.
notes.167_daina: A young woman singing with mouth open from a songbook in her hands, musical notes rising from her mouth into the air; she looks a little past the viewer. Insets: the open songbook with plain staves; a record on a turntable; a choir in a row.
notes.170_filmas: A film projector casting a bright beam onto a cinema screen that shows a plain landscape, rows of seated viewers from behind, an usher with a torch; the beam and screen are the subject. Insets: a film reel; a cinema ticket torn in half; a cinema front with a blank poster frame.
notes.171_menas: An easel holding a half-finished landscape painting of a river and a church tower, a palette and brushes on a stool beside it, a bold black arrow at the painting; a woman in a headscarf looking at it. Insets: a sculptor's hands on clay; a framed picture on a gallery wall; a folk weaving with a geometric pattern.
notes.182_duona: A dense dark Lithuanian rye loaf: near-black crust and dark brown crumb, brick-shaped, whole, with a cut slice beside it on a linen cloth; inset of hands slicing it; inset of dark rye loaves on a shop shelf. Behind, a clay jug on a plank shelf against a log wall. Every loaf on the card is the same dark rye.
notes.183_sriuba: Main picture: one deep bowl filled to the rim with steaming vegetable soup, a spoon resting in it, a slice of dark rye bread and a cup beside it on a plain cloth; the full bowl is the subject. Insets: a ladle lifting soup from a tall pot on a stove; two people eating soup at a canteen table; a second bowl of a different soup, a pale beet soup with a swirl of sour cream.
notes.209_stalas: A plain wooden kitchen table standing alone, large and central, a cloth folded on one corner; a family setting it in an inset. Insets: a table leg and joint close-up; a woman laying the table; a desk with papers.
notes.212_sapnas: A man asleep in bed on his side, a soft thought cloud above his head holding a floating dream scene of a lake, a rowing boat and a flying crane; the sleeping man with his dream cloud is the subject. Insets: a pillow and a closed eye; a night window with a moon; an alarm clock.
notes.227_raide: One single large capital letter A standing upright as an object on a plain stand, a child reaching up to it; the letter is the subject.
notes.228_rastelis: Main picture: a small folded paper note passed from one hand to another under a school desk, the note folded twice, a few short pencil lines showing through as plain strokes; two pupils' faces above, one glancing at the teacher. The folded note changing hands is the subject. Insets: the note unfolded, its lines plain strokes; a note pinned under a fridge magnet; a note tucked into a coat pocket.
notes.229_siena: Main picture: one interior wall face filling the picture, painted plain pale green to shoulder height and cream above with a thin painted border line between, a framed picture and a wall calendar hanging on it, a man pressing his palm flat on the wall; a bold black arrow pointing at the wall surface. The wall itself is the subject. Insets: a brick wall outside a house; a man plastering a wall with a trowel; a nail being hammered into a wall.
notes.246_laikrodis: The main clock reads one clear time. The insets show three different clocks, each at a clearly different time, hour and minute hands in different positions on each.
notes.250_tinklas: Main picture: a diagram of six boxy 1981 computers and telephones at desks joined by drawn cables into one web, each line meeting at a central switching cabinet; one technician plugging a cable into the cabinet. The web of connecting cables is the subject. Insets: a cable plug and socket; a wall of telephone exchange jacks; a fishing net drawn small as the same word's older sense.
notes.254_ekranas: A boxy monitor of 1981 on a desk, its screen showing a plain line diagram, a bold black arrow at the screen; the screen is the subject. Insets: a television screen; a cinema screen; a hand wiping a screen with a cloth.
notes.304_zeme: Main picture: dark soil in a freshly turned furrow with a spade standing in it, a handful of crumbly soil in cupped hands, earthworm and roots visible in the clod; the soil itself is the subject. Insets: a seedling being planted in soil; a sack of potting soil; a plough turning soil.
notes.312_oras: Main picture: a woman at an open window breathing in deeply, eyes closed, curtains lifting inward, long curving lines drawing the air flowing in from the garden outside; the flowing air lines are the subject. Insets: a bicycle pump filling a tyre; a child blowing a dandelion clock; a weather vane turning in the breeze.
notes.340_puse: A round loaf cut cleanly into two equal halves lying apart on a board, one half marked with a bold black arrow; a knife beside. Insets: an apple cut in half; a glass half full; a clock face at half past.
notes.361_vaizdas: A framed landscape picture standing on an easel in a room, a woman looking at it, a bold black arrow at the picture; the picture as an image is the subject. Insets: a photograph held in a hand; a reflection in a mirror; a picture postcard.
notes.362_rastas: A hand writing with a fountain pen across a sheet, the lines of running handwriting drawn as even flowing strokes as permitted by the text rule; the written page is the subject. Insets: an old letter with a wax seal; a pupil's exercise book; a quill and inkpot.
notes.363_dirbti: Several workmen in caps labouring together on a road surface, one swinging a pick, one shovelling, one tamping, each face different; one glances toward the viewer. Insets: hands on a shovel; a lathe operator at a machine; a woman at a sewing machine.
notes.364_zaisti: Two children in a courtyard playing with a ball, one throwing, one reaching to catch, both laughing. Insets: children on a seesaw; a girl with a skipping rope; a boy with a toy truck in a sandpit.
notes.365_groti: A man playing an accordion on a small stage, fingers on the keys, bellows open, musical notes in the air. Insets: hands on the keys close-up; a girl playing a violin; a man playing a kanklės, the Lithuanian plucked zither.
notes.366_eiti: Arrow in solid black ink. The corridor is clear of furniture.
notes.372_sustoti: The halted figure stands with one open palm raised toward the viewer and a lowered striped barrier across the road before him, a red traffic light above; the round sign he holds is a plain red disc with a white rim and nothing written on it.
notes.375_sakyti: One man speaking to another, mouth open mid-word, one hand raised in a small gesture, three short sound lines drawn from his mouth; the listener looks at him, the speaker glances toward the viewer. Insets: the speaker's open mouth close-up; the listener's ear; the two seen from the side.
notes.376_valgyti: A worker in a cap at a canteen table eating soup with a spoon, the spoon at his open mouth, a slice of rye bread in the other hand; others eating behind. Insets: the spoon at the mouth close-up; a child biting an apple; a plate of potatoes with a fork.
notes.377_gerti: A worker drinking from a glass of water, head tilted back, the glass at his lips, throat visible; a water station behind. Insets: the glass at the lips close-up; a woman drinking tea from a cup; a child drinking milk through a straw.
notes.378_zudyti: A man swatting a fly on a kitchen wall with a rolled newspaper, the arm at the end of its swing, the fly flattened beneath; drawn as a plain household moment. Insets: the rolled newspaper close-up; the swatted fly lying still; a mousetrap sprung.
notes.379_mirti: Main picture: a plain gravestone in a quiet village cemetery under birches, wilting flowers at its base, a thin candle in a glass on the grave with its flame just gone out and a wisp of smoke rising; an old woman in a headscarf standing a step back with bowed head. Insets: a wreath of fir branches; a wooden grave cross with a small roof; a single wilted flower.
notes.380_sypsotis: A young woman smiling warmly with closed lips, close portrait, eyes just past the viewer, a cardigan collar. Insets: a smiling old man; a child smiling with a missing tooth; the corner of a smiling mouth close-up.
notes.381_juoktis: Two people at a canteen table laughing openly, heads back, mouths open, one slapping the table; one glances toward the viewer. Insets: a laughing face close-up; a child laughing on a swing; a hand holding the belly in laughter.
notes.382_verkti: A woman crying, tears on both cheeks, a handkerchief raised to one eye, head slightly down. Insets: a single tear on a cheek close-up; a child crying over a broken toy; a wet handkerchief.
notes.383_pirkti: A customer receiving wrapped goods across a plain shop counter with an abacus and a scale; the shop assistant in a white smock; both looking at the goods.
notes.389_uostyti: A man at a market flower stall bending to sniff a bunch of lilies of the valley, eyes closed, drawn scent lines rising from the flowers to his nose. Insets: the nose and flower close-up; a woman smelling a loaf of fresh bread; a dog sniffing the ground.
notes.392_ragauti: A cook in a white cap at a soup pot lifting a ladle to her lips and tasting, eyes thoughtful. Insets: the spoon at the lips close-up; a man tasting a slice of apple; a hand pinching salt over the pot.
notes.393_liesti: A man's fingertip touching the smooth surface of a polished table, the point of contact marked with small drawn radiating strokes. Insets: the fingertip close-up; a hand touching a cold window pane; a child touching a cat's fur.
notes.396_buciuoti: A man kissing a woman on the cheek at a doorstep farewell, his hand on her shoulder, a small suitcase beside them. Insets: a mother kissing a child's forehead; the two faces close; a hand waving from a bus window.
notes.401_sedeti: An elderly man in the act of lowering himself onto a wooden chair, one hand on the chair back, knees bending, an arc arrow tracing the movement down. Insets: the hand on the chair back; a woman seated on a bench; a child sitting on the floor.
notes.402_stoveti: A worker standing upright at ease in a corridor, feet apart, hands behind his back, near-frontal, eyes just past the viewer. Insets: his boots planted on the floor; a man standing at a bus stop; a soldier standing at attention.
notes.407_guleti: A worker lying on his back on a rest cot, eyes open, hands folded on his chest, head on a pillow, awake and looking at the ceiling. Insets: the open eyes close-up; a man lying on grass with hands behind his head; a patient lying in a hospital bed.
notes.408_sokti: Main picture: a couple in full motion on a wooden dance floor, the woman spun out at arm's length with her skirt flaring, both feet of the man mid-step, a small band with accordion and drum on the stage behind, seated onlookers at tables along the wall, musical notes in the air. The spinning couple is the subject. Insets: three phases of one dance step, left to right: step together, the woman turning under the man's raised arm, the pair apart at arm's length; a close-up of the dancers' feet mid-step; the accordion player.
notes.409_miegoti: A worker asleep on a dormitory bunk, eyes closed, mouth slightly open, blanket pulled up, one arm hanging. Insets: the closed eyes close-up; a child asleep hugging a toy; an alarm clock on a bedside stool.
notes.411_dainuoti: Main picture: a small village choir of six singing with open mouths from songbooks, standing in a row on a low outdoor stage, a conductor seen from behind, musical notes drawn in the air above them. Open mouths and songbooks make the action clear. Insets: a close-up of one singer's face with the mouth open in song and notes in the air; hands holding an open songbook; the choir seen from the side with the accordion player. These insets replace any motion strip.
notes.412_skaiciuoti: A clerk at a stockroom desk counting on a wooden abacus with one finger, a stack of crates with plain tally strokes chalked on them, his lips pursed. Insets: the abacus beads close-up; a hand counting coins into piles; fingers held up counting.
notes.413_tuoktis: A couple exchanging rings before a registry official at a desk, the groom sliding a ring onto the bride's finger, both looking at the ring, the official facing the viewer. Insets: the two hands with rings close-up; the couple signing the register with plain strokes; guests throwing grain.
notes.419_plauti: A worker washing his hands under a tap at a tiled washroom basin, lather on both hands, water running; the lathered hands are the subject. Insets: the hands under running water close-up; a woman washing a plate in a sink; a bar of soap on the basin edge.
notes.420_gaminti: A cook at a canteen stove stirring a wide pan with a wooden spoon, steam rising, chopped vegetables on a board beside her; the stirring at the stove is the subject. Insets: the spoon in the pan close-up; a knife chopping onions; a loaded plate ready to serve.
notes.423_rasyti: A clerk writing with a fountain pen on a sheet of paper at a desk, the pen tip on the page, the written lines drawn as plain running strokes. Insets: the pen nib on paper close-up; a pupil writing on a slate; an envelope being addressed with plain strokes.
notes.424_skambinti: A worker speaking into a rotary desk telephone, the receiver at his ear, his other finger in the dial, a notepad beside; he looks at the dial. Insets: the finger in the dial close-up; a telephone box on a street; a woman answering a wall telephone.
notes.429_piesti: A child's hand drawing a simple house with a pencil on a sheet of paper, the drawing half finished, the pencil tip on the line. Insets: the pencil tip close-up; a box of coloured pencils; the finished drawing pinned to a wall.
notes.430_maitinti: Main picture: a mother at a kitchen table spoon-feeding porridge to a baby in a wooden high chair, the baby's mouth open for the spoon, a bowl and a cup of milk on the table; the mother looks at the baby, the baby faces the viewer. Feeding a person is the subject. Insets: the spoon at the baby's mouth; a grandmother handing soup to an old man in bed; a child being given a slice of rye bread with honey.
notes.431_gaudyti: A worker in a loading yard catching a tossed sack against his chest with both arms, knees bent, the thrower behind; the sack caught in his arms is the subject. Insets: hands closing on the sack; a boy catching a ball; a fisherman landing a fish in a net.
notes.433_valyti: A worker wet-mopping a corridor floor, the mopped half gleaming, a bucket beside him; the mop on the floor is the subject. Insets: a hand wiping a window pane with a cloth; someone scrubbing a floor on their knees with a stiff brush; a dustpan of dirt.
notes.434_rasti: A child who was seeking has just found another child hiding behind a garden tree, pointing with delight, the hidden child peeping out; the moment of finding is the subject. Insets: a hand lifting a cushion to find keys; a man finding a coin on the pavement; a dog digging up a bone.
notes.436_stumti: A worker leaning into a loaded handcart and pushing it forward along a warehouse aisle, arms straight, a bold black arrow ahead of the cart. Insets: the hands on the cart handle; a man pushing a stalled car; a child pushing a swing.
notes.437_traukti: A worker leaning back and pulling a rope attached to a loaded cart toward himself, the rope taut, a bold black arrow toward him. Insets: the hands on the rope; a man pulling a drawer open; a horse pulling a cart.
notes.438_nesti: A worker carrying a wooden crate in both arms across a storeroom hall toward a lorry, walking steadily; the carried crate is the subject. Insets: the arms around the crate; a woman carrying a bucket; a boy carrying a satchel.
notes.439_lauzyti: A worker in a firewood yard breaking a dry stick over his knee, the stick cracking in the middle. Insets: the two broken halves; a hand breaking a loaf of bread; a boy snapping a twig.
notes.440_deveti: A man by a wardrobe shrugging on an overcoat over a jacket, a scarf and cap already on, each worn garment marked with a small black arrow; the clothes on his body are the subject. Insets: hands buttoning the coat; feet stepping into boots; a woman tying a headscarf.
notes.441_kabinti: A worker standing on a stool hanging a framed picture on a wall hook, both hands on the frame, the hook visible above; the picture going onto the hook is the subject. Insets: the hook and wire close-up; a coat hung on a peg; washing hung on a line.
notes.442_purtyti: A worker gripping the trunk of an apple tree and shaking it, apples falling with short motion lines, a woman holding out her apron below. Insets: the hands on the trunk; a hand shaking a bottle; a rug being shaken from a window.
notes.443_pasirasyti: A hand signing a document with a fountain pen, the signature a plain scribbled line, an official looking on across the desk; the pen at the signature line is the subject. Insets: the scribbled signature close-up; a rubber stamp beside the pen; two people shaking hands over the paper.
notes.444_musti: A woman beating a hanging rug with a wicker carpet beater on a yard rack, dust puffing out with each stroke, the beater raised. Insets: the beater striking the rug close-up; a cook beating eggs in a bowl; a drummer striking a drum.
notes.445_kelti: A worker lifting a crate straight up from the floor with bent knees, a bold black arrow pointing up beside it; the crate rising in his arms is the subject. Insets: the hands under the crate; a man raising a child above his head; a crane hook lifting a load.
notes.454_letas: Tortoise moving slowly as the main subject; the hare awake and running at full stretch in its inset, so the fast/slow contrast is unmistakable; any resting hare is curled up with eyes closed, clearly asleep.
notes.528_serti: A farm worker tipping feed from a bucket into a long wooden trough while pigs and a cow push in to eat; the feed pouring into the trough is the subject. Insets: a hand holding hay to a horse; a bucket of mash; a calf drinking from a pail.
notes.529_lesinti: A woman in an apron scattering grain from her apron to hens and chicks pecking at her feet in a farmyard; the grain falling to the birds is the subject. Insets: a hand throwing grain; a chick in a palm; a bird table with sparrows.
